_doc: The economy's numbers (E4-S1; D56, D57, D58; docs/design.md Economy and time has a line for each), read by course/economy_tuning.gd (EconomyTuning). Dollars unless named. tile_price is what painting one tile with that surface costs: the fitted T4 table (fairway 5, rough 2, green 25, tee 15, bunker 20, water 30, trees 10, cart path 8, oob 2, $10 a height step) times the money scale 0.61 (D56), rounded to whole dollars; oob costs rough's price. height_step_price is one step raised or lowered on one tile. Tee markers and cups are free. Repainting charges the new surface and refunds nothing for the old; undo refunds exactly what its step charged (D56). The starting balance is land_budget in data/land.json (D57), the rating window rating_window in data/guests.json. Arrivals a day: arrivals_base + arrivals_per_star x stars, at most arrivals_max, times the fee curve: 1 up to fee_full_arrivals_share of the ceiling, then a straight drop to ceiling_arrivals_share at the ceiling (D58). The ceiling is fee_ceiling_per_star x stars per round. Rating: the mean of rating_points over the window; a window short of rating_window is padded with neutral reactions and a reaction cleared by an edit counts as neutral (D58). E4-S8 tunes these against Balance targets, economy (/balance economy).
